title: Courtesy Reduction for Appointments Northgate Moved — Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Late-change courtesy reduction.** On a customer's reschedule of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a courtesy reduction is taken off for appointments Northgate itself moved. The number of such moves is the order's reschedule count less the customer's confirmed reschedule requests on the order.

| Northgate moves recorded on the order | Taken off |
|---|---|
| two or more | 30.00 |
| exactly one | 15.00 |
| none | nothing |

**Hypothetical record.** An order showing a reschedule count of 3 with 1 confirmed customer reschedule request has 2 Northgate moves, so 30.00 is taken off; a count of 2 with 2 confirmed requests has no Northgate move and nothing is taken off.
